sources.title: FLUX.Fill-dev(gguf) q8 - Checkpoint for Flux.1 D | CivArchive
sources.snippet: FLUX.1-Fill-dev Quantized represents a breakthrough in efficient diffusion models for image editing. Built on Black Forest Labs' original architecture and optimized through GGUF quantization, it delivers professional-grade inpainting and outpainting capabilities while maintaining impressive performance even on consumer hardware.
